title: console: Packaged Automation shows "On" for scheduled flows that are not bound and will never run
body:
Filing gate **③ a task the maintainer set**: objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2188, the maintainer's browser pass of 2026-10-20. Each defect gets its own card, by the maintainer's ruling 「按照按照具体的issue单独提交卡片，不受数量限制。」 (recorded on objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2188, `6283467378`). This is finding **F-07** of track 2 (Setup as the system administrator), by the cloud tester `session_01VuXyJvhGKJy8qeUvhKyxzv`. It was measured on HotCRM `main` `f22dfa52` with `@objectstack/*` 18.0.0-next.5, in Chromium at 1440×900 on a locally booted, seeded install. The evidence is on the branch `claude/qa-setup-pass-2026-10-20` at `ed4f40e42`, which is never merged. Filed by the `repo:hotcrm` seat 2 (`os-support-ai`, session `session_01KqkTQNLcxVc588eZpJmp1r`). ⛔ Not a claim. Grade: triage's.

**Reader (who acts):** objectui triage routes it. Paths under `src/` are HotCRM's (objectstack-ai/hotcrm).

## The finding, as measured

- **Persona / URL:** dev admin, `/component/automation/packaged`.
- **Expected:** "Activation" reflects whether the flow runs. The boot reports 8 schedule flows "NOT bound — disabled by deployment policy" (`OS_AUTOMATION_SCHEDULED_WORK_ENABLED` unset).
- **Actual:** all 8 (Case SLA Monitor, Contract Auto-Expiration, Forecast Snapshot, …) show a green switch and "On"; only a small "Details" chip tells the truth.
- **Evidence:** [`03-apps-packaged-automation-details.png`](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotcrm/blob/ed4f40e42b8b6ce059a4e648f25f8f6037ffd9f6/qa/2026-10-20-setup-pass/shots/03-apps-packaged-automation-details.png), `sweep-[`03-packaged-automation.png`](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotcrm/blob/ed4f40e42b8b6ce059a4e648f25f8f6037ffd9f6/qa/2026-10-20-setup-pass/shots/03-packaged-automation.png).
- **class: a.** **Reach:** every deployment without scheduled work enabled (the default).
- **Suspected landing:** objectstack `console` automation/packaged component.
- **Dedupe words:** packaged automation on but not bound, schedule disabled by deployment policy.

## Seat review

- **Landing (seat review):** objectui `PackagedAutomationPage.tsx`. The report suspected objectstack's `console`, which is the prebuilt objectui app.

## Dedupe

Method: semantic `search_issues` on objectstack-ai/objectstack and objectstack-ai/objectui, open and closed, using the finding's own dedupe words and a second phrasing; plus a grep of every issue title (objectstack #1–#24751, objectui #7–#13153) listed through the repo-scoped `issues?state=all` endpoint, because the semantic search can miss title words (objectstack#14743).
- 9 hits in objectstack, 6 in objectui. objectui#12609 (closed 2026-10-16, in this pin) named "the switch reflects the effective state" in its target, but its triage narrowed it to row height. objectstack#23842 (the classifier field) is closed. **New** (the residual of #12609).
